name: Build Frontend Portal Pages
description: Create the Student, Teacher, and Parent portal pages for the Next.js frontend with role-based layouts, Brain Map visualization, and dashboard components.

subtasks.name: Build Student Portal
subtasks.description: Create frontend/src/app/student/page.tsx with: 3D Brain Map visualization (via brain-map module), mastery probability display (CI ranges), spaced repetition queue, micro-interaction dashboard. Dark glassmorphism aesthetic.

subtasks.name: Build Student Revision Page
subtasks.description: Create frontend/src/app/student/revision/page.tsx with: concept review cards sorted by forgetting priority, spaced repetition timer, mastery progress rings showing Beta distribution CIs.

subtasks.name: Build Teacher Dashboard
subtasks.description: Create frontend/src/app/teacher/page.tsx with: class-wide heatmap (uncertainty-aware), risk stratification tier list, student mastery overview, real-time alert feed.

subtasks.name: Build Parent Portal
subtasks.description: Create frontend/src/app/parent/page.tsx with: privacy-safe mastery ranges (CI-derived), weekly progress snapshot, engagement metrics, empathetic progress narrative.

subtasks.name: Build shared components
subtasks.description: Create reusable components: MasteryRing (probability ring), ConfidenceBand (CI visualizer), RiskBadge (tier indicator), BrainMapEmbed (3D viewer wrapper).

subtasks.name: Wire portal routing
subtasks.description: Update frontend/src/app/layout.tsx with role-based navigation, create shared layouts for each portal, ensure correct Next.js routing.
